states: tall supporting pane with internal overflow
expected_effects: Main document can continue scrolling while the supporting pane remains within its sticky range.
Supporting pane obtains its own vertical scroll only when its content exceeds available viewport height.
Narrow viewports restore normal document flow instead of squeezing the two-column layout.
Translucency/blur is an optional visual variant independent from sticky positioning.
limitations: Reference mechanism demo, not a golden visual baseline.
Does not claim production styling for MKV-Fast-Muxer or any other project.
